rules.naturalLanguage: Payment terms must be 30 days or fewer.
rules.lambda: input1.text.Contains("30 days") || input1.text.Contains("15 days") || input1.text.Contains("net 30") || input1.text.Contains("Net 30")
rules.remediation: Replace the {section.heading} clause with: "Customer shall pay all undisputed invoices within {meta.maxDays} days of the invoice date."
rules.evidenceQuote: Customer shall pay all undisputed invoices within 45 days
rules.sourceContent: Customer shall pay all undisputed invoices within 30 days of the invoice date. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month.

rules.naturalLanguage: Governing law must be a U.S. jurisdiction.
rules.lambda: input1.text.Contains("United States") || input1.text.Contains("Delaware") || input1.text.Contains("New York") || input1.text.Contains("California")
rules.remediation: Replace the {section.heading} clause with: "This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of {meta.requiredJurisdiction}."
rules.evidenceQuote: governed by the laws of the State of Delaware
rules.sourceContent: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, USA.

rules.naturalLanguage: Data protection clause must reference an industry security standard.
rules.remediation: Add to the {section.heading} clause: "Provider shall maintain security controls aligned with {meta.requiredStandard}."
rules.sourceContent: Provider shall maintain administrative, technical, and physical safeguards consistent with ISO 27001 to protect personal data.
